data.notes: I used all 12 searches. Values are taken from ADAC Autokatalog, Audi MediaCenter, carwow, Auto Bild, motor1 and similar sources. Missing values are null rather than guessed. Remaining gaps: A5 Avant combustion trunk, Q5 FY combustion trunk, and the e-hybrid trunks of the new A6 Avant and Q3. Wherever I only remembered a value (A5 Avant 476/1527, Q5 FY 520/1520) it is in notes/notFound, not in the data. I added Q3 Sportback and Q4 Sportback e-tron because they belong to the segment; Q3 Sportback has low confidence and is partly empty.
